senses.definition: (countable) A long, thin piece of land; any long, thin area.
examples: The countries were in dispute over the ownership of a strip of desert about 100 metres wide.

senses.definition: (usually countable, sometimes uncountable) A long, thin piece of any material; any such material collectively.
